description: This Java class implements the JournalEntryAggregationWriterService, providing methods to insert, rollback, and convert journal entry summaries and tracking data within the Fineract project. It interacts with repositories and manages journal entry aggregation data.

classes.name: JournalEntryAggregationWriterServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the JournalEntryAggregationWriterService interface, handling journal entry summary and tracking data persistence and rollback.

methods.name: insertJournalEntrySummaryBatch
methods.description: Converts a list of summary data objects to entities and saves them in bulk.

methods.name: insertJournalEntryTracking
methods.description: Logs the insertion and saves journal entry tracking data.

methods.name: rollbackJournalEntrySummary
methods.description: Deletes journal entry summaries associated with a specific job execution ID.

methods.name: rollbackJournalEntryTracking
methods.description: Deletes journal entry tracking data associated with a specific job execution ID.

methods.name: saveJournalEntryTracking
methods.description: Creates and saves a journal entry aggregation tracking entity from DTO.

methods.name: convertToJournalEntrySummary
methods.description: Converts summary DTO to JournalEntrySummary entity.
